title: Core on‑prem entry bundle and SQ response pathway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise prospects frequently request a lightweight on‑prem starter option that reduces procurement friction (lower upfront license fee, simplified SOW) while still meeting basic compliance needs. At the same time, sales and legal spend a disproportionate amount of time running down Security Questionnaires (SQs) for similar asks. This ticket pilots a two‑pronged experiment: 1) an 'Entry Bundle' packaging for small on‑prem/VPC customers that standardizes license fee, support baseline, and upgrade cadence; 2) a pre‑built SQ response pathway (templated answers, prevalidated artifacts, and an 'SQ playbook') to reduce response time and legal review cycles.
goals: 1) Reduce average procurement lead time for on‑prem deals under $250k ARR by 30% within the pilot. 2) Reduce average SQ turnaround for Entry Bundle prospects from 12 business days to 3 business days by providing a validated answer set and artifacts. 3) Validate that an Entry Bundle can be offered with conservative upgrade cadence without increasing post‑install operational tickets above baseline.
metrics:
- Procurement lead time (days) for deals <$250k ARR
- SQ turnaround time (business days) for Entry Bundle prospects
- Number of follow‑up security clarifications per SQ
- Post‑install operational tickets (first 90 days)
- Conversion rate from POC to paid (Entry Bundle)
- ARR uplift and churn at 6 months
proposed_packaging:
Proposed 'Entry Bundle' (pilot):
- License fee: fixed annual fee (example band: $12k–$30k depending on CPU/GPU footprint) with a simple seatless capacity metric.
- Included: 12 months of maintenance + standard support (email, 48h SLA for severity 1).
- Optional add‑ons: accelerated bugfix SLA (24h), first‑line operations pack (10h/month ops support), 'upgrade acceleration' for customers wanting faster patch windows.
- Entitlements: single VPC/airgapped installation, quarterly change window for major upgrades (opt‑in for monthly security patches).
Rationale: Lowering legal/price friction while keeping predictable support exposure and a clearly documented upgrade cadence.
proposed_support_tiers:
Support tiers for the pilot (names and boundaries):
- Standard (included): email + triage, 48h S1 response, no guaranteed patch SLA, community KB access.
- Plus (paid add‑on): 24h S1 response, security patch bundle within 30 days, up to 10h/month ops labor.
- Critical (not part of Entry Bundle by default): 4h S1 response, hotfix SLAs, phone escalation, contractual uptime SLA (move customers to Dedicated).
upgrade_cadence: Default upgrade policy for Entry Bundle: quarterly major upgrade window, monthly security patch stream (customer may opt out). Customers can purchase 'accelerated upgrade' for monthly major windows. Engineering trade‑off: preserve predictable upgrade scheduling to limit engineering oncall churn vs. giving customers faster security fixes. Pilot will track ops load from opt‑ins.
security_questionnaire_plan: SQ playbook components: (a) templated answers for common frameworks (SIG, SOC roadmap, data flow), (b) pre‑packaged artifacts: architecture diagram, network hardening checklist, KMS/HSM integration guide, audit log sample, and incident response runbook; (c) a curated redacted customer on‑prem whitepaper validating logging and patching cadence. Delivery model: self‑serve link + curated 'fast track' where Sales attaches the playbook to incoming questionnaires and Legal signs a one‑time attestation for template accuracy. Trackable artifact: Confluence page + versioned PDF. Links: Confluence/drive/arch-diagram (placeholders), GH PR for template automation (placeholder).
rollout_plan: 1) Week 1: finalize Entry Bundle pricing bands, prepare legal SOW template and Confluence SQ playbook draft. 2) Week 2: create Sales facing collateral and 'SQ fast track' checklist; onboard 3 pilot customers (sales selected). 3) Week 3–8: deploy pilot installs, collect SQ response times, run monthly short surveys with customers about upgrade tolerance. 4) Week 9: analyze metrics, determine expansion criteria or iterate packaging. Communication channels: weekly cross‑functional sync (PM/Legal/Sales/Eng), dedicated Slack channel #pm-entrybundle. Success criteria: meeting KPI reductions listed in goals.
acceptance_criteria:
- Legal SOW and canned contract language approved and checked into contracts library.
- SQ playbook published and downloadable; at least one live SQ responded to using the playbook with time <3 business days.
- 3 pilot customers under Entry Bundle signed and installed; post‑install ops ticket volume within 20% of baseline.
- Sales collateral live and Sales enablement session completed.
